coral.origin: Source-domain CORAL, following DomainBed mean/covariance matching; same downstream CNN
coral.adaptation: T1/T2 source conditions are domains. Equal-domain component-wise BCE plus mean/covariance alignment with weight 1; total batch 64; source-only validation; no target-domain training data.

diffucd.origin: Journal-paper reconstruction from Zotero attachment WZKZMQKR
diffucd.adaptation: 1D CGE-UNet, encoder self-attention, decoder cross-attention, numerical condition encoder, 1200-step schedule, generated-cluster 70-percent filter. Widths and the filter implementation are recorded in method_sources.json.

ccgan.adaptation: 1D residual conditional-BN generator, projection discriminator, two-stage label embedding, multidimensional soft-vicinal hinge objective.

iccdm.adaptation: Upstream matrix-form EDM and Heun sampling with a 1D denoiser, trained conditional covariance, adaptive vicinal neighborhoods and multi-hot fault input.

time_weaver.adaptation: Native patched TimeWeaverCore with numerical condition projection, source-only selection and inherited T2 adaptation.

flowts.adaptation: Native trend/Fourier transformer with continuous conditioning, linear flow objective, time scaling and shifted Euler sampling; equivalent SDPA replaces explicit attention products.

mixstyle.origin: 1D task adaptation of author algorithm, MIT
mixstyle.adaptation: Temporal mean/std instead of spatial mean/std; cross-source-condition partners; unchanged diagnostic CNN parameters.
